definition.interpretation: The measured divergence slope (0.0013) falls within the noise margin (tolerance 0.005) relative to zero, suggesting that the previously observed preference divergence may be indistinguishable from stochastic fluctuations in the current episodic retrieval weighting.
definition.limitations: Small trial count (30) limits statistical power to differentiate between subtle emergent divergence and noise.
definition.next_step: Scale trial count to 500 to improve measurement precision of the divergence slope.

definition.method: Increase trial count to 500 to evaluate if divergence slope stabilizes above the 0.005 noise threshold.
definition.stop: Measurement exceeds 500 trials or indicates clear convergence to 0.
definition.success: Divergence slope mean significantly greater than 0, or consistent convergence to 0 across 500 trials.
